Add a list of your own

One item per line, or separated by commas: an English headword, a Latin word (macrons optional) or the last part of an entry’s address (brush-teeth). The list stays on this device.

Within a group the choices add up (Cicero or Vergil); between groups they narrow (Cicero, within the kitchen). A group with nothing chosen does not narrow.

Open the entry

Space or Enter shows the Latin; then 1 for Again, 2 for Got it.

Progress cannot be saved in this browser: it will last only until the page is closed.

Backupexport or import your progress

Your progress and your lists are kept on this device only. Export them as text to keep, or to move to another device; import puts them back, and for each card the later answer wins.
